name: Mindszentgodisa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mindszentgodisa (a quartered shield of red and blue with ears of grain, a church, a cross and a ploughshare) below the name MINDSZENTGODISA in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
